summary: BELLA DONNA JERNBANETORGET AS (org. no. 980 295 133) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-18. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.780 (Annen detaljhandel med andre nye varer); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 22 021. Board chair: Sveinung Frode Sandvik.
